pages.text: Put an Essence of Superposition in the $(l:qcraft:qblocks/faces)face grid$(/l). Fill East with Gold Block and every other face with Stone. Hover the output to check East and West.
pages.title: Pick an Axis

pages.text: Observe from the east or west. The block chooses one of those two opposite faces. Look away from several blocks away to reset it, and look back. A new trial can repeat the last result.
pages.title: Repeat the Trial
Inert Quantum Block
pages.text: An unobserved Quantum Block has its own inert appearance. To repeat a trial on demand, use an $(l:qcraft:automation/observer)Automated Observer$(/l).
